Subject: POC/Trial planning — RACI & success criteria (HorizonCare)

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation. Per our discovery, I captured a concise recap, proposed success criteria, and a suggested evaluation plan + timeline. Please review and flag anything we've missed.

Recap (short):
- Goal: Run a 4-week POC to validate Redwood Inference for clinician-facing summarization and search workflows (EMR notes ingestion + context-aware generation).
- Constraints: Data residency in US, no PHI leaving your VPC during setup; SSO via SAML; procurement needs PO and standard A2A terms.

Proposed success criteria (suggested):
1) Latency: p95 <= 300ms for generation on 1024-token window for internal test traffic.
2) Quality: Rouge-L + human evaluation on 200 sample cases >= baseline (details in attached evaluation_plan.md).
3) Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions during peak simulation without degradation.
4) Security/compliance: no persisted PHI outside your environment; SOC2 evidence reviewed.

Evaluation plan & timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, infra access + account provisioning. Owners: Aditya (infra), Lauren (app integration), Dev (security), Rishi (procurement).
- Week 1: Data ingestion (anonymized sample), model pin + baseline eval.
- Week 2: Integration testing with sandbox EHR endpoints, latency/load tests.
- Week 3: Fine-tune/parameters, edge-case QA with clinical SME.
- Week 4: Wrap, final eval, decision point + executive summary.

Ownership / RACI (draft):
- Infra (VPC, network routing, GPU instances): Responsible = Aditya Rao; Accountable = Marissa Cole; Consulted = Dev Patel; Informed = Lauren Bishop
- App integration (API wiring, client-side changes): Responsible = Lauren Bishop; Accountable = Marissa Cole; Consulted = Aditya Rao; Informed = Dev Patel
- Security & compliance (data handling, SAML, audit logs): Responsible = Dev Patel; Accountable = Rishi Malhotra; Consulted = Aditya Rao; Informed = Marissa Cole
- Procurement & contracts (PO, terms, procurement queue): Responsible = Rishi Malhotra; Accountable = Marissa Cole; Consulted = Elena Rivera (HorizonCare); Informed = Mike Thompson

Attachments: POC_RACI_v1.xlsx (RACI matrix), evaluation_plan.md (detailed test cases).

Next steps:
1) Elena — confirm success criteria and procurement timeline.
2) Rishi — can you confirm the PO cadence / required contacts at HorizonCare?
3) Aditya/Dev/Lauren — request access details for sandbox environment (drive link + SAML IdP metadata).

Happy to set a 30-min runbook meeting tomorrow to lock owners if that helps.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this is very helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: We typically need a 30-day PO processing window after receiving a quote; I can loop in our procurement lead if needed.
- PHI/data: We can do anonymized sample data for weeks 1–2; for week 3 we would prefer on-premise-only testing (no data leaving our environment) — please confirm Redwood's ability to run in our VPC or via a private deployment.
- SOC2: We need to review SOC2 Type II report and evidence around access controls (can you share the SOC2 cert or a link?).

Success criteria: Latency target is fine; for quality we would prefer a pass-rate metric (e.g., >= 85% clinically acceptable summaries on a sample of 200) — happy to provide the rubric.

I'll confirm procurement contact and timeline by EOD. Attached is our internal POC requirements doc for reference.

Elena
